name: T2I-CompBench
intro: T2I-CompBench（原始NeurIPS 2023版本）用6000条提示评测文本到图像模型的组合生成能力，覆盖颜色、形状、纹理、空间关系、非空间关系和复杂组合六个子类。本条目固定对应arXiv v2，不混入后续8000提示的CompBench++。
org: The University of Hong Kong, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab
build_method: 规则模板与ChatGPT生成、六子类均衡、已见/未见组合划分、人工验证
eval_feature: 开放世界组合生成, 六子类, 每提示生成10张图
scale: 6000条提示（六个子类各1000条；每类700训练、300测试）
build_method_en: Rule templates and ChatGPT generation, six-subcategory balancing, seen/unseen composition splits, and human validation
eval_feature_en: Open-world compositional generation, six subcategories, ten images per prompt
intro_en: T2I-CompBench (the original NeurIPS 2023 version) uses 6,000 prompts to evaluate compositional text-to-image generation across color, shape, texture, spatial, non-spatial, and complex compositions. This entry is pinned to arXiv v2 and does not mix in the later 8,000-prompt CompBench++.
scale_en: 6,000 prompts (1,000 per subcategory; 700 train and 300 test each)
metric_en: BLIP-VQA, UniDet, CLIPScore, 3-in-1, MiniGPT4-CoT, and human rating

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Original T2I-CompBench conference paper arXiv:2307.06350v2 Sections 3-4 and 6.2; official Karine-Huang/T2I-CompBench repository and project page. This entry intentionally excludes the later T2I-CompBench++ v3 expansion.. This entry follows the original NeurIPS 2023 T2I-CompBench conference version, not the later 8,000-prompt T2I-CompBench++. The original benchmark contains 6,000 prompts across three categories and six subcategories: 3,000 attribute-binding prompts for color, shape, and texture; 2,000 relationship prompts for spatial and non-spatial relations; and 1,000 complex-composition prompts. Each subcategory has 1,000 prompts split into 700 training and 300 test prompts with seen and unseen compositions balanced. Rules and ChatGPT generate template and natural prompts; color prompts combine CC-500, COCO, and ChatGPT sources, spatial prompts include seven relation types and contrastive swaps, and complex prompts cover four scenarios. Models generate ten images per prompt. Disentangled BLIP-VQA multiplies independent object-attribute probabilities, UniDet and geometric rules score spatial relations, CLIPScore evaluates non-spatial relations, and the 3-in-1 complex score averages CLIP, BLIP-VQA, and UniDet. MiniGPT4-CoT is an auxiliary unified metric. Human validation samples 25 prompts per subcategory, two images per prompt, and three MTurk raters who use a normalized five-point scale.
